title: TabPFN model screens for cough variant asthma from routine laboratory data
summary: A multicenter study used a retrospective development set (n=533; 428 training, 105 internal testing) and two prospective validation sets (internal n=59, external n=78) with 54 routine biochemical, coagulation and hematological markers. A TabPFN model was benchmarked against XGBoost; in external validation TabPFN reached AUC 0.858 (95% CI 0.763-0.943), accuracy 79.5%, sensitivity 71.4% and specificity 86%. XGBoost had a higher external AUC (0.912) and sensitivity (91.4%) but lower accuracy (75.6%) and specificity (62.8%) at a fixed 0.5 threshold; validation sets are small.
ai_technology: Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN) classifier benchmarked against XGBoost

evidence.tested: Prospective internal and external validation sets (n=59 and n=78) after retrospective development.
evidence.unknown: Whether the validation was done with a frozen model before outcomes were known, and performance in larger cohorts; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Screens for cough variant asthma from routine laboratory values
